name: card-binder
blurb: Catalogue a trading-card collection with a camera: photograph a card — or a whole binder page — and it works out which print it is, prices it against the market, and files it away in a binder you can sort and export. Magic, Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh. It is what fills the Cards shelf in Collections.
built: Node 22 standard library · SQLite · vanilla JS · Canvas

name: cairn
blurb: A local-first markdown notes editor. Two files, the Python standard library and git: a folder of .md files is the entire data model.

name: midi-scope
blurb: A live MIDI analyser — a waveform scope, pitch detection against any reference tuning, and a GPU spectrogram you fly through in 3D — with a tone generator you play from the on-screen keys, the pads, or your controller's knobs.
built: TypeScript · Web MIDI · Web Audio · WebGL2

name: mrwr.dev
blurb: A Windows-95-flavoured desktop in the browser — windows, a start menu, and a heap of small apps. You're looking at it.
